answer_1.quote: In this paper, we introduce Relationship-driven Story Generation where given a prompt sentence and a set of inter-character relationships, the goal is to generate a story following the prompt sentence which exhibits the desired relationships between the characters.

answer_2.quote: We define two automatic and reference-less metrics to measure relationship faithfulness... For automatic assessment of content quality, we use the standard n-gram overlap based metrics such as BLEU, and ROUGE scores... For evaluating diversity of generation, we use Distinctn (n = 1, 2, 3) to measure the percentage of unique n-grams.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct human evaluation of the generated stories using Amazon Mechanical Turk... We show workers a pair of stories generated from two different models using the same prompt sentence and relationship set as input. We then ask the workers to compare pair of stories based on three criteria: (1) content quality, (2) relationship faithfulness, and (3) overall.
answer_4.guideline: Workers compare stories based on three criteria: content quality, relationship faithfulness, and overall preference.
